extraction.notes: Searched the whole report for technology and AI material only, as the analyst instructed (keyword search plus reading of every hit in context, and of the chapter introductions and summaries); no other content extracted. No Chapter 2 content. Pages 65 and 66 carry only page numbers (checked against the PDF: no text or images). Not extracted as out of scope under rules 0.4 (R22: other sector digital systems; incidental mentions): European Electronic Tolling Systems and the Open Balkan toll interoperability, intelligent transport systems and the ITS strategy, digital and smart tachographs (except item -0004), rail and air traffic management interoperability (technical, not information systems), aviation cybersecurity measures (one act in a list of aligned acts), the European train driver register plan (EU-level intention), smart meters and data management in the electricity market, gas data exchange rules, the regulator's market monitoring software, the Environmental Information System and water information system (publishing information), Natura 2000 data software and 'digitalisation' of nature protection, the planned IT Forest timber tracing system, the car registration IT system for CO2 standards, anti-corruption 'digitalization of procedures' and digitalisation recommendations in transport and energy, and the integrity monitoring software. Speaker conventions: country presentation parts are North Macedonia's reported view; Commission assessment parts are the European Commission. period_covered is empty in the register and not stated in the report. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
